blocks.title: We’re hiring.
blocks.intro: Send your resume to info@nscltd.ca with the position in the subject line. Don’t see your role? Send it anyway.

items.a: Send your resume to info@nscltd.ca with the position in the subject line. If you don't see your role listed, send it anyway.

items.q: What roles does NSC hire for?
items.a: Field and trades, including pipelayers, equipment operators, labourers, foremen and superintendents. Project delivery, including project managers, project coordinators and estimators. Engineering and technical, including construction technologists, EITs, QA/QC and utility coordination.
On projects across [Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley](areas/index.html). Our head office is in Richmond and our equipment yard is in Langley.

items.q: What kind of projects would I work on?
items.a: Sewers, watermains, school sites, roadworks and site servicing for municipalities, school districts and builders. See our [projects](projects/index.html).

items.q: What is the safety program like?
items.a: NSC is COR certified through the BC Construction Safety Alliance, with a safety officer on our sites and a toolbox meeting every shift. See our [safety page](safety.html).
